# Paths no pull request may change unless the repo owner applies the `owner-approved-paths` label by hand
# (from github.com or the gh CLI, not through an app). One extended regex per line, matched against the
# repo-relative path. Read from the BASE branch by .github/workflows/agent-guard.yml, so a pull request
# can't loosen its own rules.

# CI, guardrails, agent settings and rules
^\.github/
^\.claude/
^CLAUDE\.md$
^AGENTS\.md$
^docs/agents/TASKS\.md$

# deployment and infrastructure
^fly\.toml$
^Dockerfile$
^\.dockerignore$
^scripts/deploy
^next\.config\.ts$
^instrumentation\.ts$
^package\.json$
^package-lock\.json$

# database, auth, secrets, email, rate limits, tenancy and HTTP plumbing
^lib/(db|auth|secret|ratelimit|http|email|emailverify|storage|ssrf|paths|errors|schemas)\.ts$

# signing, sealing, certificates, the audit trail, webhooks, conversion and detection
^lib/(files|signer|audit|consent|webhooks|convert|detect|worker)\.ts$
^lib/pdf/
^app/s/
^app/api/
^app/actions\.ts$
^components/(SigningRoom|SignaturePad|VerifyForm)\.tsx$

# shared test infrastructure and evidence that must not be regenerated by an agent
^playwright\.config\.ts$
^e2e/helpers\.ts$
^e2e/support/
^e2e/visual\.spec\.ts-snapshots/
^fixtures/holdout/
^fixtures/final/
^fixtures/agreements/
